arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent game sprite converting the first pixel reference into the clean outlined Cartoon style of the second reference. Image1 is exact pose/action/silhouette authority; its diagnostic palette is not material truth. Image2 is IDENTITY AND MATERIAL ONLY, never a pose template. Same adult small worker: black cap, green long-sleeve shirt, royal-blue bib overalls, tan face/hands, dark shoes, crisp black ink and simple cel shading. A deep crouching forward fold toward screen-left, torso almost horizontal and head low on the left looking left/down. The near arm folds under/in front of the face and crosses the chest; the far arm rises diagonally behind toward UPPER-RIGHT, with separate attached shoulder. Screen-left leg supports below the torso; screen-right leg bends back with foot farther right. Preserve open elbow/chest gap. Exactly two arms; the upper-right shape is the raised arm, not a third leg. No props. Preserve source whole-body proportions, exact facing, bent joints, hand overlap and prop positions. Show only limbs actually visible. No third arm/sleeve, floating hand, added equipment, scenery, ground, cast shadow, glow, text or watermark. Genuine transparent RGBA background, ample clear padding around every extremity and attached prop, smooth contours rather than tracing pixel stairs.
